I've noticed a slight softening in fine lines, a brightening effect and overall just plumper and more hydrated, glowy skin. It has this kind of instant lifting and firming effect that just makes your skin look tighter and more even. The phyto oxygen line is my fav line from Dermalogica and they knocked it out of the park with this one! Kindly gifted by Dermalogica.

I am loving this serum so much! This has done wonders for my skin by making it look and feel softer, while also helping to prevent any texture and lines. This whole line of products has been great to use. Gifted by dermalogica

avis.titre: This Is a Must Have in Your Anti-Aging Routine!
avis.texte: Gifted by Dermalogica. What an amazing serum! This serum absorbs seamlessly into the skin. My skin drinks it up and begs for more. It isn't greasy and doesn't sit on top. The light scent is very pleasant. After applying it my skin instantly feels and looks tightened. New must have staple in my anti-aging routine!

I received Phyto Nature Firming Serum complimentary from Dermalogica. The serum has a nice consistency and it quickly and absorbs and leaves my skin hydrated. It is easy to use and feels soothing and moisturizing.

I received this item complimentary from Dermalogica. I have never seen such quick results from a skin care product. I used this last night for the first time and I woke up this morning and my skin looked incredible! It was clear and bright and smooth. The applicator is very unique in that it has two separate chambers to keep the active ingredients separate. The only minor issue is the scent. It's not perfumey at all but a bit medicinal almost menthol? This will not deter me at all from continuing to use it every night.

This serum is awesome! I gotta hand it to dermalogica, they've never let me down with their products. I just started using anti aging things and this made my skin GLOW and after a week I noticed my face feeling like I didn't even want to wear makeup today I felt like I looked more awake like wow. Gifted by dermalogica thank you

This serum is very good for my dry and premature skin. It hydrates my skin instantly and absorbs into the deep layer of skin quickly. I noticed my fine lines are much less noticeable and skin looks glowing. It also works very well with my other skin care products without any issues. It's gifted by dermalogica

This product is very interesting to me, and in terms of the main ingredients that they claim are going to lift the skin. I am a little skeptical, overall, the application and absorption work well in tandem with my other skincare products. The smell is not my favorite and the price is a little outrageous. Gifted by Dermalogica.

avis.titre: Pair it with the moisturizer from the same line!!
avis.texte: I am in my late 30's and trying my best to defy the effects of gravity with skin care products that pack amazing ingredients. after so much researching and trial and error, I have found myself to be a major Dermalogica fan. I already use the moisturizer from this line, and I'm super excited to be pairing that with this firming serum. I also love the glowing effect. This combo seems to have on my skin. I totally plan on using this long-term. Offered by Dermalogica.
It makes my skin look so much healthier and better. It gives back life to it . The Serum protects my skin giving back so much healthy looking effect. A little bit goes a long way

I received the Phyto-Nature Firming Serum complimentary from Dermalogica and I must say how impressed I am! It's lightweight, absorbs quickly, and layers beautifully underneath my daily moisturizer. I have noticed my texture is overall more smooth since adding this serum into my routine!

This serum is feels really nice on the skin. My face feels smooth and hydrated after using this, and it also doesn't make my face sensitive. Overall I'm impressed with this product and I also like that it works well with my toner and cream and doesn't make my makeup pill. Gifted by dermalogica

I received this firming serum complimentary from Dermalogica. Amazing product which does what promises. It minimizes the pores, increases the skin luminosity. My skin is firm and hydrated. I would highly recommend it to everyone!

The ingredients are amazing. They includes all the natural extract that against free medical pollution damage and for antioxidant purpose. Came Camu is also rich in Vitamin C. Hyaluronic Acid hydrates my skin over the night. The formula is not very greasy and great for combo to dry skin. Gifted by Dermalogica.

Dermalogica creates some of my all time favorite skincare products. So I was so excited to try the new Phyto Nature Firming Serum. This is more of a serum/oil hybrid. This is going to really help hydrate and nourish the skin while also helping to reduce the appearance of fine lines, wrinkles, firmness, and elasticity. Great for both day and night and works well under makeup.

The serum probably works for some. My skin is smoother. But, it also causes my face to breakout. Also the price is very high. I have had great results with other Dermalogica products. This one is very disappointing.

I debated this purchase as it is pricey but I am glad I did! With patience and consistency it has improved the texture around my mouth and lower cheeks. I've begun using it just prior to my home red light treatment too. I believe it improves the absorption.
Love the photo nature oxygen cream but the photo nature firming cream burned my skin. This one is not for me and I'm upset I spent 155.00 for a product I can't use.

I've been using the phyto nature oxygen cream at night for a while now and absolutely love it. It made such a difference to my skin's look and feel. It creates this beautiful glow every single time and makes my skin feel nourished and "happy". Because of my great experience with the phyto cream, I decided to try out the phyto-nature firming serum --- it's quite a bit more expensive than what I'm comfortable with actually, but I'm glad I did try it. It has a beautiful rich texture and glides on easily. I feel like my skin looks younger - and more glow-y. I'm really happy with this serum and am so thankful that Dermalogica launched both of the phyto products -- the cream and the serum. They've made such a difference for me. Even though I use the phyto cream every night, I don't use the serum every night... I use it about two or three times at night -- I don't feel like I need it every night at this point, and also, this way the bottle lasts longer. Oh, and a little goes a long way!
I have purchased multiple bottles of this serum to have the same issue. The dual product does not come out of the pump. Too expensive to not fix the known issue.

I decided to splurge on the oxygen cream and serum because it looked so good for your skin. When I put it on my face, it made my face get bright red and feel itchy. My entire face looked extremely red. There was also very little serum in the bottle for the high price. I will never buy again.
Very nice product, goes on easily. Not oily for combination skin
Love this product, I've noticed am improvement in fine lines after using for 3 weeks!

avis.titre: Steam Iron fix for fine lines
avis.texte: Seems to work on the fine lines under the moisturizer and primer and makeup!
Another luxury that actually works. Always choose this as one of my samples!

avis.titre: Pump does not work for phyto-nature firming serum
avis.texte: Pump does not work on this product. Only one serum comes out.
I have been using this for a year I love it though it is expensive

This product is great—-when the pump works. Most of the time, one side of the pump clogs and requires constant cleaning in order to get both serums to pump. This needs to be improved, as I can longer purchase this product even though I like it. Too wasteful and inefficient for the price.
It was way to harsh for my skin. My skin became red and inflamed and it took several days for it to subside.
Love the way my skin feels and looks, but the smell is awful. I am returning it.
It keeps my skin soft and smooth. Great for the over 40 crowd!
The pump doesn't work properly. There is supposed to be two types of serums that come put ywo different chambers and we mix together in our palm but only one side comes out and not the other.
Please re-work the dispenser. It doesn't work. The product is fantastic when the it dispenses correctly. The company was great about my return! Five stars to Dermalogica!!!
